title: Off-base doctor asks 'had they let you see the alien bodies yet'

tellings.quote: goes let me ask you something um had they let you see the alien bodies yet

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who once worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about a time he was posted to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. He says a doctor he saw off the base leaned in and asked him, "had they let you see the alien bodies yet?" The story matters because it suggests that, around that base, the idea of stored alien bodies was something even locals talked about.
